concept.title: Immediate help in a mental health crisis
concept.shortdesc: As someone in a mental health crisis or having thoughts of ending my life, I need to reach help right now, so that I am safe.

conbody.note: Draft need (N-021). The needs catalogue is a model's draft from persona use cases and has not been agreed with stakeholders; the category links are proposals and are not confirmed.

section.title: The need
section.p: Who: people in mental health crisis, people at risk of suicide.
Situation: Time-critical; ranking must never bury it.
A good result: Fixed routes always shown first (emergency services, NHS 111 mental health option, Samaritans), then local crisis services and walk-in support.
How much it matters: Safety: a miss could leave someone at risk, so the bar is highest.
